basePath.description: Shared prefix. Supports {name}, e.g. "/mcp/{name}". Omit for per-server /<slug>/mcp.

ssoCallbackPort.description: Loopback port of the shared SSO callback (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback). Every server uses the same URL because Keycloak registers one redirect URI per client.

authApiUrl.description: SSO/token issuer. Defaults to apiUrl. Backends that do not serve /api/v1/sso-* (e.g. workspace) point this at the TDEI core that issues the bearer.

ssoCallbackUrl.description: Optional override. Must be identical for every server (and registered in Keycloak); defaults to http://127.0.0.1:<ssoCallbackPort>/callback.

profile.description: Instruction profile. Defaults to workspace for workspace-looking names/hosts, otherwise core.
